product_overview: A bilingual Agra luxury taxi and tour platform comprising a React customer portal, an administrative operations desk, and a Fastify API. The customer experience features outstation corridors (980+ routes), curated tour packages, local sightseeing charters, an extended fleet showroom, a five-step booking funnel with 3s pre-checkout and 7s post-payment countdown overlays, and instant branded PDF voucher downloads. The operations desk provides fleet catalog onboarding with 25+ presets and an asset library picker, a review invitation studio with live WhatsApp and scannable QR code generation, booking management with PII unmasking audit logs, 30-minute pending booking auto-expiry, and idempotent refund execution.
core_goals: Help customers discover Agra taxi, intercity, vehicle, and package services in English and Hindi with SSG-optimized sub-second performance.
Make transparent server-authoritative fares available before commitment, dividing fares into a 28% advance deposit and 72% chauffeur cash balance.
Deliver seamless booking confidence through 3-second bank-grade pre-checkout encryption overlays and 7-second dispatch verification countdown overlays.
Issue branded A4 booking confirmation PDF vouchers instantly via customer downloads and Resend email attachments.

Provide operations staff with role-based dashboards for bookings, fleet catalog onboarding with presets, live image previews, review moderation with WhatsApp QR studio, finance, and immutable audit history.
Protect booking, payment, admin, webhook, and personally identifiable data with default PII masking and logged unmasking events.
Maintain high uptime and zero hydration mismatches through static review snapshot architecture and dual-origin staging support.

key_features.name: Customer marketing site & bilingual routing
key_features.description: Responsive React pages for home, routes, services, fleet, packages, about, contact, FAQ, privacy, and terms with English/Hindi parity.

key_features.name: Fare discovery & server-authoritative tariff
key_features.description: Route and vehicle selection with one-way/round-trip calculations, night allowance, tolls, taxes, driver allowance, and commercial exception rules.

key_features.name: Five-step booking funnel with countdown overlays
key_features.description: Journey search, vehicle selection, customer intake with guest token continuity, 3s bank-grade pre-checkout encryption overlay, payment gateway, and 7s dispatch verification overlay.

key_features.name: Branded PDF confirmation voucher & secure download
key_features.description: A4 PDF generation with @pdfme, containing ticket ID, route itinerary, fare breakdown, chauffeur dispatch rules, and customer download action (#btn-download-pdf-voucher).

key_features.name: Pending booking 30-minute auto-expiry worker
key_features.description: Background interval worker expiring unconfirmed pending bookings older than 30 minutes to cancelled.

key_features.name: Static review snapshot & customer submission flow
key_features.description: Homepage reviews marquee rendered statically from build-time snapshot with zero runtime API dependency, and verified review intake at /review/:token.

key_features.name: Admin fleet catalog onboarding & asset library picker
key_features.description: Fleet catalog with 25+ model presets across 4 canonical groups, status filters (Missing in Fleet, All Catalog, Active), template auto-fill dropdown, 35+ high-res image library picker, and live 16:9 photo preview.

key_features.name: Admin review invitation & WhatsApp QR studio
key_features.description: Dispatcher studio for generating verified review invitation URLs, 1-click WhatsApp sharing, live canvas QR code rendering, and printable PNG QR download.

key_features.name: Bookings operations desk & PII privacy
key_features.description: Fast lookup, status transitions, optimistic concurrency control via expectedVersion, default PII masking with audited unmasking, and manual offline payment recording.

key_features.name: Finance reconciliation & idempotent refunds
key_features.description: 28% advance deposit ledger, 72% chauffeur cash collection ledger, and idempotent refund execution requiring mandatory audit reason and idempotencyKey.

key_features.name: Security, RBAC & immutable audit trail
key_features.description: Dual auth modes (Supabase production / demo role switcher in test), 5 granular roles, request IDs, and append-only audit logging for all mutations.

user_flow_summary: Customer navigates English/Hindi routes, configures a journey, and views transparent fare calculations.
Customer completes the booking flow and clicks 'Proceed to Secure Payment', triggering the 3-second bank-grade encryption countdown modal.
Customer completes payment, triggering the 7-second dispatch verification modal before routing to the confirmation pass.
Customer views the confirmed reservation pass and clicks 'Download PDF Voucher' to retrieve the branded A4 PDF.
Unconfirmed pending bookings automatically transition to cancelled after 30 minutes of inactivity.
Verified customers open /review/:token, fill out ratings and feedback with pre-filled ticket details, and submit for moderation.
Admin logs in with role credentials, manages active bookings, and unmasks customer PII with logged audit entries.
Admin opens Fleet Management (/vehicles), browses missing catalog presets, auto-fills vehicle specs from presets or the 35+ image library picker, and verifies live 16:9 photo previews.
Admin generates review invitations in the Review Studio (/reviews), shares via WhatsApp, or downloads printable QR codes for chauffeur clipboards.
Finance operators review captured advance deposits and execute idempotent refunds with audit justifications.
validation_criteria: All customer and admin pages load with zero uncaught console errors and clean network requests.
Pre-checkout 3s countdown modal and post-payment 7s countdown modal render with progress circles, badges, and dismiss/proceed actions.
Booking confirmation page exposes #btn-download-pdf-voucher and delivers a valid %PDF file without leaking credentials.
Fleet catalog on /vehicles supports filtering by missing/active status, template auto-fill, asset library image selection, and live 16:9 preview.
Review Studio on /reviews generates active URLs, formats WhatsApp links, renders HTML5 QR canvas, and exports PNG files.
PII unmasking on /bookings requires explicit dispatcher action and records UNMASK_CUSTOMER_PII audit logs.
Refunds on /finance require confirmation, a mandatory reason, and an idempotency key to prevent double payouts.
SSR pre-rendering matches client hydration tree with zero React Error #418.
Accessibility complies with WCAG 2.1 AA (contrast, keyboard navigation, aria-modal, reduced motion).
Security scanners verify zero backend secret leakage across all client bundles.
